Package neqsim.process.processmodel

Class ProcessSystem.InPlaceInitialState

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.ProcessSystem.InPlaceInitialState
Enclosing class:
ProcessSystem
private static final class ProcessSystem.InPlaceInitialState extends Object
Identity-preserving checkpoint of the initial state. Every unique process element's transient snapshot, and the recycle controller's state, are serialized together so that each ProcessSystem.reset() restores a fresh copy into the same objects. References from a snapshot to live process objects (elements, their streams and controllers) are written as tokens and resolved back to the same live objects, matching the semantics of a transient step transaction. Only built when the transient transaction coverage of the process system is complete.
